snapshot.title: STARTEX: Heat Wave — Stale Signal & Transmission Break

fields.staffing: Full shift: duty operator at HMI, second operator on-site; IT, WQ, and security on call
fields.narration: STARTEX. This is an exercise. It is 05:30 on Saturday, October 24, 2026. The City of Millbrook is under a heat wave, and system demand is near 14 MGD. The Riverside Water Treatment Plant is operating normally; all key systems are online and within setpoint. SCADA HMI displays are green across all zones. The weather is clear and hot, with a forecast high of 97°F. The shift has just started; the duty operator is on the control desk, and the second operator is on-site for the day shift. All status indicators are normal.

status.name: Riverside Water Treatment Plant (RWTP)
status.note: All units online, process within setpoint

fields.facilitatorNote: Confirm all players have the ICS 201 form, the SCADA HMI display, and the Emergency Response Plan (MDWS-ERP-2026). The exercise begins now.
